entradas.text: "I'm glad they released the governor."
"And they did not harm anyone. Everything has gone incredibly well so far."
"Why exactly did they release him?"
entradas.menu: "Why exactly did they release him?"

entradas.text: "You are saying that but your eyes speak differently."
entradas.menu: "You are saying that but your eyes speak differently."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your service, Mr. Leke."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your service, Mr. Leke."

entradas.text: "Don't mention it. I did this for my people, and for Sordland."
"I haven't slept in days, Mr. President. And of course, it was tough being around heavily armed men, if that's what you're trying to get at..."
"They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."
"Apparently, nobody expected you to hold talks with them."
"But they did release Mr. Bron, didn't they? They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."
"If my service helps with the unity of our people, I would never hesitate to do it."
"And luckily, the meeting went well. They even released Mr. Bron, saying they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."
"So they gave away their bargaining chip just like that?"
entradas.menu: "So they gave away their bargaining chip just like that?"

entradas.text: "And how about you?"
entradas.menu: "And how about you?"

entradas.text: "What did you tell them to make this happen?"
entradas.menu: "What did you tell them to make this happen?"

entradas.text: "To be completely honest, me neither."
"Judging by your previous actions against... us."
"Yes. They don't want violence. They only want their voices to be heard."
"Nothing."
"I, and the whole delegation only relayed your intentions to find a diplomatic solution."
"As I said, they took that as a gesture of goodwill."
"What? Are you defending them now?"
entradas.menu: "What? Are you defending them now?"

entradas.text: "And what were their demands?"
entradas.menu: "And what were their demands?"

entradas.text: "Oh, now they are *against violence*?"
entradas.menu: "Oh, now they are *against violence*?"

entradas.text: "It's *us* now?"
entradas.menu: "It's *us* now?"

entradas.text: "Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, let alone stand with them. I only support the Bludish people."
"But you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."
"Because you have left them no choice."
"What? No."
"Of course I do not support the actions of the BFF, nor try to defend them."
"While I do not support any of their actions, you must understand they have a lot of Bludish people supporting them today."
"Many in their ranks were young men, probably recruited from the villages in Bergia. They are led to believe the BFF is the only way to make their voices heard."
"Good. Tell me about the meeting."
entradas.menu: "Good. Tell me about the meeting."

entradas.text: "First of all, they want the region of Bergia to be made autonomous. They want the local populace to be able to govern themselves."
"I should have known sending a Blud was a mistake."
entradas.menu: "I should have known sending a Blud was a mistake."

entradas.text: "Everything I've done was out of necessity."
entradas.menu: "Everything I've done was out of necessity."

entradas.text: "So, I'm to blame for this attack?"
entradas.menu: "So, I'm to blame for this attack?"

entradas.text: "Just tell me about their demands."
entradas.menu: "Just tell me about their demands."

entradas.text: "Our people have suffered a lot through the short history of this republic."
"Even though this state keeps denying it, all of us know this to be true."
"And I should have known that you meant none of it. At your speech during the Izzam Anniversary."
"There is no excuse for oppressing a group of people, Mr. President."
"I'm just another *Blud* for you, am I not, Mr. President?"
"You have only fed the stigma and discrimination, reinforcing this vicious cycle."
"Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me or the armed separatists who attacked our nation's energy source?"
entradas.menu: "Who's reinforcing this cycle? Me or the armed separatists who attacked our nation's energy source?"

entradas.text: "I advise you to watch your words, Mr. Leke."
entradas.menu: "I advise you to watch your words, Mr. Leke."

entradas.text: "Look. I'm doing my best to support the Bludish people."
entradas.menu: "Look. I'm doing my best to support the Bludish people."

entradas.text: "I don't want to be disrespectful, Mr. President. We have an important matter to discuss here."
"I don't want these meetings to fall flat. Especially not because of me. Please excuse me for my language."
"Let's try to achieve something for them with this meeting then."
"I will tell you what the BFF told me."
"Let's move on to what the BFF demanded."
He took a deep breath.
"These are their demands. They want the governor dismissed and the Special Zone's current structure to be abolished."
He took out a piece of paper and stood up.
He walked up to me and placed the paper in my hands.
"They want a local assembly to be formed responsible for all regional affairs of Bergia..."
He returned back to the couch and sat down.
"...which is elected by the residents of the region."
"They also want the revocation of the ban on the Workers Party of Bludia and the Bludish Freedom Party..."
"They also want the revocation of the ban on the Bludish Freedom Party..."
"...And the revocation of both the Unified Education Language Act and the Religious Harmony Act..."
"And the revocation of the Unified Education Language Act..."
"And the revocation of the Religious Harmony Act..."
"...as well as amnesty for every Bludish prisoner who was arrested for alleged separatist actions. Including Dewlen Arge."
"And here I thought we could have a diplomatic solution..."
entradas.menu: "And here I thought we could have a diplomatic solution..."

entradas.text: It had been a very long time since I heard that name. He was dubbed "The Bludish Terror" by Tarquin Soll when he led the BFF against the state in 1935.
Nobody had really spoken of him since his arrest more than 10 years ago.
"I'll do it. For the sake of peace."
entradas.menu: "I'll do it. For the sake of peace."

entradas.text: "There is no way I can accept such demands."
entradas.menu: "There is no way I can accept such demands."

entradas.text: "These points seem fair to me."
entradas.menu: "These points seem fair to me."

entradas.text: "So, you'll initiate the attack then? After they released the governor?"
Mansoun looked at me as if he was trying to figure out if he understood me correctly.
Mansoun looked at me with surprise.
"So, you'll comply with their demands then?"
"Yes. I'll write a decree and sign it immediately."
entradas.menu: "Yes. I'll write a decree and sign it immediately."

entradas.text: "Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I don't have the authority to sign such decrees anymore."
entradas.menu: "Yes, but I'll need the Assembly. I don't have the authority to sign such decrees anymore."

entradas.text: "You heard me. I'll give them what they want."
entradas.menu: "You heard me. I'll give them what they want."

entradas.text: "We'll put them in a bill and propose it to the Assembly immediately."
entradas.menu: "We'll put them in a bill and propose it to the Assembly immediately."

entradas.text: "Yes. I cannot accept these demands. And we cannot let them destroy the Soll Dam."
entradas.menu: "Yes. I cannot accept these demands. And we cannot let them destroy the Soll Dam."

entradas.text: "No. We'll make a counter offer."
entradas.menu: "No. We'll make a counter offer."

entradas.text: "Should I relay the message?"
"Go ahead and gather the team. I'm counting on you."
entradas.menu: "Go ahead and gather the team. I'm counting on you."

entradas.text: "No. You've done enough. I'll have someone else do it."
entradas.menu: "No. You've done enough. I'll have someone else do it."

entradas.text: "I hope they listen to you. The Assembly is full of anti-Bludish sentiment."
"I wouldn't think I'd regret supporting limiting presidential decrees."
He sighed.
"I will only accept the amnesty."
entradas.menu: "I will only accept the amnesty."

entradas.text: "I can do it except the autonomy."
entradas.menu: "I can do it except the autonomy."

entradas.text: "First, they will have to put down their weapons and surrender."
entradas.menu: "First, they will have to put down their weapons and surrender."

entradas.text: "You think they'll accept that?"
"They will if they truly desire a diplomatic solution."
entradas.menu: "They will if they truly desire a diplomatic solution."

entradas.text: "We have to try."
entradas.menu: "We have to try."

entradas.text: "If they don't, I will have no other choice but to destroy them."
entradas.menu: "If they don't, I will have no other choice but to destroy them."

entradas.text: "This will only result in more death and destruction in Bergia."
"I'm glad they didn't harm anyone. Everything has gone incredibly well so far."
"But they did release Mr. Krull, didn't they? They said they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."
"And luckily, the meeting went well. They even released Mr. Krull, saying they wanted to return the gesture of goodwill."
"Well.. Me neither."
"These are their demands. They want the centralization of Bergia to be cancelled and the Interior's control over the region to be taken away."
"So, you'll initiate the attack then?"
